北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天阳光正好，体感稍凉，记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing, but feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有霾体感冷，北风 4 级。外出请戴口罩、注意保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Hazy and chilly in Cixi with brisk winds. Wear a mask and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海今天有霾，体感 5℃。外出记得戴口罩、多穿衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Shanghai, feels 5℃. Wear a mask and dress warmly if heading out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光好，但风力 6 级体感冷！外出务必防风保暖。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Guangzhou, but strong winds make it feel cold! Dress warmly against the wind.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气晴朗，体感 10℃。北风 4 级，注意防风哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Shenzhen, feels 10℃. Mind the moderate north wind.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天体感 4℃，略显湿冷。记得多添衣保暖哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and feels 4℃ in Hangzhou, a bit damp and cold. Remember to layer up!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感已是 -3℃。西风 5 级，注意防风防寒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Nanjing, feels -3℃. Strong winds, so bundle up against the cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光正好，体感 9℃。南风 3 级，保湿也很重要哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Chengdu, feels 9℃. Moderate south wind, remember to moisturize too.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉今天阳光好，但北风 4 级体感 5℃。注意添衣别着凉！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Wuhan, but feels 5℃ with north winds. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阳光虽好，体感 3℃。湿度 9%，注意补水防干燥哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Xi'an, but feels 3℃. Very dry at 9% humidity, so stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 10℃。微风习习，注意保湿哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy in Chongqing, feels 10℃. Gentle breeze, remember to moisturize.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -15℃！多云、风力 4 级。务必全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: It feels -15℃ in Harbin! Cloudy with moderate winds, make sure to bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阳光好，但体感 -2℃。南风 3 级，出门注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Shenyang, but feels -2℃. Moderate south wind, dress warmly if going out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感 -1℃，东北风 4 级。湿冷感强，注意防寒哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and feels -1℃ in Kunming with northeast winds. It's damp and cold, so stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 11℃。体感舒适，仍注意保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xiamen, feels 11℃. Humid and pleasant, but still dress comfortably warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 1℃。出门请戴口罩，添衣保暖哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Qingdao, feels 1℃. Wear a mask and dress warmly if you head out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阳光好，但体感已是 -3℃。西南风 5 级，注意防风保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Dalian, but feels -3℃. Strong southwest winds, so stay warm against the wind!
